name: Review browser security headers
limitations: Missing defensive headers are posture candidates; this does not prove an exploit.

name: Validate session cookie attributes
limitations: Only explicitly named session cookies are evaluated. Application use still needs review.

name: Validate credentialed CORS policy
limitations: Confirms response policy behavior, not browser access to every resource.

name: Validate external redirects
limitations: Requires the redirect parameter. Redirects are inspected without following them.

name: Validate response header injection
limitations: Tests one parameter with a harmless custom header; other parser/proxy paths are not covered.

name: Validate Host header redirect handling
limitations: Only Host-derived external redirects are checked, not complete reset/cache poisoning chains.

name: Review HTTP methods and TRACE reflection
limitations: Advertised methods are observations. TRACE echo is not proof of browser credential theft.

name: Detect exposed directory listings
limitations: Intentional public indexes require researcher interpretation.

name: Detect detailed error disclosure
limitations: Detects known stack-trace/error signatures; absence does not prove safe error handling.

name: Validate exposed Git HEAD metadata
limitations: Reads HEAD and a negative control only; does not reconstruct repositories.

name: Review exposed source backup variants
limitations: Checks three filename suffixes for source/secret signatures, without saving response bodies.

name: Review published source maps
limitations: Published sources can be intentional. Only same-origin sourcesContent is assessed.

name: Review form anti-CSRF indicators
limitations: Missing form token fields are candidates; SameSite, Origin checks, and workflow behavior require manual validation.

name: Review HTTPS pages for HTTP resources
limitations: Only static script, iframe, stylesheet and media references are inspected, not browser runtime behavior.

name: Check GraphQL schema introspection
limitations: Schema availability is an exposure candidate and can be intentional.

name: Check bounded GraphQL query batching
limitations: Two read-only queries establish batching support only, not a rate-limit or resource-exhaustion bypass.

name: Validate horizontal authorization boundaries
limitations: Requires distinct owner/peer credentials and a private response marker for an object the peer must not access.

name: Validate vertical authorization boundaries
limitations: Requires privileged/unprivileged credentials and an explicit private marker. Roles are supplied, not inferred.

name: Validate tenant isolation boundaries
limitations: Requires credentials from distinct tenants and an explicit private marker; tenant ownership is supplied.

name: Validate authenticated resource protection
limitations: Requires a private marker and a credentialed baseline; removes standard and declared credential headers for control.

name: Review cross-identity private response isolation
limitations: Demonstrates cross-identity exposure; cache causation requires cache-specific investigation.

name: Review server-side logout invalidation
limitations: Requires an explicit logout request, private marker, and state-change permission. Logout policy still requires review.

name: Validate server-side arithmetic evaluation
limitations: Uses two random arithmetic canaries; does not execute commands or prove arbitrary code execution.

name: Validate traversal to a researcher canary
limitations: Requires a researcher-controlled canary filename and private content marker; never defaults to system files.

name: Validate SSRF with independent callback evidence
limitations: Requires an owned callback and independent monitor. No metadata/internal-address payload list is supplied.

name: Validate XML external-entity callback behavior
limitations: Requires an XML endpoint, an owned callback/monitor, and state-change permission. No local file retrieval.

name: Validate JWT signature enforcement
limitations: Requires a bearer token, private marker, and an anonymous negative control. Tests one payload mutation.

name: Validate rejection of unsigned JWTs
limitations: Requires a bearer token and private marker. Tests alg:none acceptance with other credential headers removed.

name: Validate researcher-defined workflow invariants
limitations: Requires explicit valid/invalid request sequences and a forbidden-outcome marker. No invariant or business impact is inferred.
